3277-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
3277-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1003-5006-6797-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-5006-6797-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

1939-4279-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1939-4279-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2023-4518-6006-6791.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-3698-5131-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

3263-5686-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-5686-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Shilgengar.

4399-4770-7055-7818.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Thornscape Familiar.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-7055-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2104-5144-7487.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and exiling Ephemerate.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1430-4004-7149.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Mirror Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirror Image dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Mirror Image enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mirror Image from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5075-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-5075-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Ogre Slumlord and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-5243-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5243-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1409-3129-4716.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1409-1449-2397.description:
Activate Plundering Barbarian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve both Plundering Barbarian triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5497-6632-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Water Crystal.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-1322-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

930-5330-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1874-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1874-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3532-5060-5078-6608.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled by Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3129-4050-4533-4807.notablePrerequisites: You control less than three Blood tokens.
3129-4050-4533-4807.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Falkenrath Forebear, adding {B}.
When Falkenrath Forebear dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster triggers, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Falkenrath Forebear by paying {B} and sacrificing the Blood tokens, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3734-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Phyrexian Metamorph
3734-5299-5466.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phyrexian Metamorph's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Phyrexian Metamorph's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Phyrexian Metamorph's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

3327-4549-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
3327-4549-6797.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1274-3197-5070.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-5070.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3767-3918-5116-5929.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
3767-3918-5116-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
3767-3918-5116-5929.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1692-2099-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Helm of the Host attached to Lonis.
1692-2099-5365.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lonis.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1692-2099-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

765-1479-1659.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-1659.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Seed the Land, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3443-3869-4067.notablePrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness. You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
3443-3869-4067.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.

618-2724-5111.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Manta with haste.
When Wormfang Manta enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to skip your next turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, causing you to sacrifice Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability triggers twice, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn, skipping it due to Wormfang Manta's trigger from step 2.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

913-1641-2034-4452.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

234-411-803-3309.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Merrow Reejerey triggers, untapping Twinning Glass.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand from the battlefield, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Activate Twinning Glass by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to cast Grinning Ignus without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3180-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
3180-5220-5243.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Chamber Sentry on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1168-1361-1651-1737.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ancient Den.
The Ancient Den token enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo, creating a Rock artifact equipment token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Ancient Den token and the Rock token, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.
